method: Same aec09d6 core source four-run two-lifetime ABBA original-A/candidate-B/candidate-B2/original-A2. Both one/native bank, current mask and peak, same allocation/raster/draw/upload/artist code; only the complete CardRasterCache class module differs at the exact current PaintedCardBatches import. Joint two-hit admission and constructor-default budget policy: original 48MiB and candidate 16MiB; not same-budget isolation, no retained-entry recovery. Cache and CPU ownership/cost changes are reported, not asserted equal. GPU rasterization/upload/copy counts, page layout, geometry and render order remain strict invariants. All raw samples pooled across four lifetimes per policy, not selected or averaged quantiles. All 24 PNGs are decoded and compared at zero RGBA tolerance; original-A supplies six phase/lifetime image oracles.

baselineProvider.scope: Combined admission plus budget policy using complete cache classes on the same current renderer; original 48 MiB versus explicitly recorded candidate budget (default 16 MiB). Not a same-budget admission comparison; no production integration or per-frame observer. Cache counters, true Canvas misses and CPU ownership may change and are not asserted equal. PNG pixels, picking, facts and GPU page/upload behavior require separate measured comparison, not assumptions.

cacheMetadataAccounting.reason: Source stores only key observations on first paint; raw probationEntries measures the separate count bound. JS Map/key/object metadata has no measured byte attribution. ownedCpuBytes tracks declared buffers and must not be treated as a complete JS metadata estimate.

limits: ABBA retains four lifetimes/240CPU/48real per policy, including all cold/slow samples. Balanced order reduces simple drift but this sample set does not prove stable tails, hardware generalization or final shipping performance. Complete wall is GPU-completion/scheduling, not GPU nanoseconds/FPS.

Combined admission plus constructor-default budget policy is tested on aec09d6, not integrated production and not the entire historical renderer. Admission counters, true Canvas misses, ghost-key counts and CPU ownership may differ. Encoded entry and probation key caps are separately checked; ghost JS metadata bytes are unmeasured. Stage/cache work costs are cumulative, not only timed CPU rows; avoidedPaintMs is an estimate, not measured total frame benefit.
Full/World3D/Canvas timings are nested/residual and cannot be added. Cold real samples remain in headline values. No allocation profiler or GC attribution.
